items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an algebraic stack which is reduced and quasi-separated with irreducible underlying space is integral (author lemma at source lines 10686-10691, label lemma-totaro-case). The proof (source lines 10693-10705) derives decency from quasi-separatedness, obtains quasi-compactness of the inertia from quasi-compactness of the diagonal by base change, and checks the clauses of the definition of an integral stack while recording the sharper hypothesis (proof lines 10694-10704). The verification of the defining clauses through the diagonal and the inertia is the content. H3.
